x: Nicholls (Tipton) and Vernon (Aldershot) put in the two fastest runs of stage five as the autumnal Sutton Park squalls began bending the trees and showering spectators and racers alike.

Aldershot had made a major bid for victory through Andy Vernon on stage four and with the Bels back in 7th at the beginning of that leg many onlookers must have thought that the Hampshire club were lining themselves up to regain the “Ian Logan Cup” that had last been in their hands after the race of ’99.
